decisionText: The pinned physical fixtures are admissible as static external-selection evidence for the 18 current SDD empty-request obligation cells, but they do not define an expected-output oracle and do not authorize campaign execution. The materialized SDD suite matches the selected cell set, but one generated transition case has guardResult=unknown and must be excluded or version-corrected before official execution.

used: fixture materialization manifest and byte structural check

selectedCells.title: Arquivos externos e abertura
guardBasis: open_status=00 is selected by package physical-resource presence only
request body remains {}
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: OPEN DALYTRAN input, TRANFILE output, XREF input, DALYREJS output, ACCOUNT I-O, TCATBAL I-O; status diferente de 00 em qualquer OPEN chama erro/abend.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Somente todos os OPEN status 00 permitem entrar no loop de DALYTRAN.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: JCL é evidência documental; não prova alocação local, commit ou durabilidade.

selectedCells.title: Loop DALYTRAN e EOF
guardBasis: read_status=00 selected by non-empty DALYTRAN sequential input
EOF/other/UnknownEOF are not selected here
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: READ DALYTRAN status 00 mantém END-OF-FILE=N e processa; status 10 move END-OF-FILE=Y; outro status abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT incrementa somente para leituras status 00. EOF seleciona fechamento sem expectativa sobre conteúdo estável do receiver.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Não assumir retenção de último registro no EOF nem conteúdo observável do buffer após status 10.

selectedCells.title: Validação de cartão
guardBasis: xref_exists has concrete present and absent source-bound records in DALYTRAN/CARDXREF family
no expected result is derived
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: READ XREF por DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM; INVALID KEY define razão 100 e descrição INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Cartão ausente rejeita com trailer 100 e não entra em POST.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Não há validação de formato além da busca.

selectedCells.title: Validação de conta, limite e expiração textual
guardBasis: account_exists=true and account state fields are source-bound in ACCTFILE for the present card
negative/expired variants are not selected
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Conta ausente razão 101; conta presente calcula credit-debit+amount, razão 102 se excede limite; depois compara ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10) e pode mover razão 103.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Conta inexistente rejeita 101; overlimit rejeita 102 salvo se expiração textual também falhar, caso em que a razão final sustentada é 103.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Comparação de datas é textual X(10); calendário real não é decidido.

selectedCells.title: Rejeitos e return-code
guardBasis: reject branch is externally selectable by DALYTRAN record with card absent from XREFFILE
reject output contents remain outside expected authority
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.preconditions: Razão de validação diferente de zero.
modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Incrementa contador, escreve 350 bytes originais + trailer 80; ao final RC=4 se reject count>0.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Cada rejeição alcançada gera um registro de rejeito; execução normal com algum rejeito retorna 4.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Não afirma rollback de sucessos anteriores.

selectedCells.title: TCATBAL create/update
guardBasis: tcatbal_status=00 branch has package-local TCATBALF indexed resource and matching category key
status 23 and failure status other are not selected
limits: TCATBALF contains key 10000000001010005 for the accepted 4111111111111111/01/0005 path, so status 00 is selected.
No present-card transaction has a missing TCATBALF key, so status 23 is not selected by this fixture.
The failure status other / abend branch is not selected and no output oracle is created.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Chave = XREF-ACCT-ID + type + category; status 23 cria registro inicializado, status 00 atualiza; ambos somam DALYTRAN-AMT; status diferente de 00/23 em READ ou diferente de 00 em WRITE/REWRITE abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Ausente cria saldo com amount; existente reescreve saldo+amount; falha nesta etapa impede ACCOUNT/TRANFILE.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Status aceitos 00/23 no read; sem atomicidade/durabilidade.

selectedCells.title: Arquivos, parâmetro e abertura
guardBasis: open_status=00 is selected by package physical-resource presence and PARMFILE bytes
request body remains {}
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.preconditions: Job INTCALC com PARM e DDs documentais.
modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Abre TCATBAL input sequencial, XREF/DISCGRP input, ACCOUNT I-O, TRANSACT output; falha abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: PARM-DATE participa de TRAN-ID nas transações geradas.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Data do JCL é exemplo de fonte, não calendário universal.

selectedCells.title: Varredura e agrupamento por conta
guardBasis: tcatbal_read_status=00 selected by non-empty TCATBALF sequential input
EOF/other are not selected here
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: A cada registro status 00, se TRANCAT-ACCT-ID muda, atualiza conta anterior exceto primeiro registro, zera total e carrega nova conta/xref.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Modelo depende de registros contíguos por conta; conta reaparecida depois vira novo grupo.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Ordenação não é verificada pelo programa/JCL.

selectedCells.title: Leitura ACCOUNT e XREF por conta
guardBasis: new group account/xref lookup has matching ACCTFILE primary keys and XREFFILE alternate keys
missing lookup is not selected
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Lê ACCOUNT por TRANCAT-ACCT-ID e XREF por alternate key FD-XREF-ACCT-ID; status não 00 abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: ACCOUNT fornece grupo/id; XREF fornece cartão para transação de juros.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Índice alternativo é evidenciado no JCL, mas ambiente VSAM não é executado.

selectedCells.title: Taxa específica ou DEFAULT
guardBasis: disc_rate_path specific and zero are concretely source-bound by selected account groups
DEFAULT fallback and missing-group branch remain unselected
resourceChecks: interest:DISCGRP:keys include STANDARD/ZERORATE; DEFAULT resource exists but fallback is not selected
limits: ACCTFILE/TCATBALF select STANDARD and ZERORATE records only.
DISCGRP includes DEFAULT as a resource, but no account/group combination forces status 23 and fallback DEFAULT.
The missing disclosure-group / abend branch is not selected and no interest-output oracle is created.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Lê DISCGRP por group/type/category; status 23 tenta group DEFAULT preservando type/category; DEFAULT ausente abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Usa taxa específica se existe; se ausente tenta DEFAULT; default ausente abende.

selectedCells.title: Fórmula e guarda de juros
guardBasis: rate nonzero and zero partitions are selectable by DISCGRP records; formula expected output is not generated
resourceChecks: interest:DISCGRP:keys include nonzero and zero rates
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Só se DIS-INT-RATE != 0 calcula (TRAN-CAT-BAL*DIS-INT-RATE)/1200, acumula WS-TOTAL-INT e escreve TX.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Taxa zero não gera transação; taxa diferente de zero gera valor pela fórmula fonte.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Arredondamento/truncamento/overflow dependem de PIC/compilador; não fixado.

selectedCells.title: Campos da transação de juros
guardBasis: interest transaction field sources are available as parameter and lookup bytes
write outcome remains unchecked
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

resources.source: explicit package-local X(10) PARMFILE from v1 manifest parameter, not default

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: TRAN-ID=PARM-DATE+sufixo; type 01; cat 05; source System; desc Int. for a/c + ACCT-ID; amount mensal; merchant zero/spaces; card XREF; timestamps current.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Cada cálculo escreve uma transação de sistema com esses MOVEs.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Representação física de PIC 9(04) após MOVE literal 05 requer revisão COBOL, não fixture.

selectedCells.title: Contexto JCL e arquivos
guardBasis: previous not_mapped for SDD reporting is corrected in the versioned copy: /reporting operation plus external reporting package supply the selectable file context
SORT/REPROC execution is not claimed
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: REPROC descarrega, SORT ordena por card e filtra por proc date, STEP10 roda CBTRN03C com arquivos de lookup e report.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Modelo espera input ordenado por cartão para que quebras façam sentido.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: JCL não foi executado; datas do SORT podem divergir do DATEPARM.

selectedCells.title: DATEPARM e filtro textual antes do EOF
guardBasis: DATEPARM 2022-07-01..2022-07-31 and TRANFILE with at least one 2022-07 record select date_window=in_range
EOF receiver behavior not selected
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Lê start/end X(10); após cada READ TRANFILE, inclusive quando EOF foi marcado, testa TRAN-PROC-TS(1:10) >= start e <= end antes do ramo END-OF-FILE. Fora do intervalo executa NEXT SENTENCE.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Somente registros cujo texto de proc date está no intervalo alcançam lookups/detalhe; fora do intervalo não produz detalhe nem acumula valor. EOF só alcança totais se o valor observável/retido em TRAN-PROC-TS satisfizer o teste textual.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Sem validação calendárica. Conteúdo do receiver em EOF é desconhecido quando não há autoridade de runtime; seleção EOF pode ser condicional/unknown, não fixa.

selectedCells.title: Leitura TRANFILE e EOF condicional
guardBasis: TRANFILE includes an out-of-range August record against July DATEPARM, selecting the skip-detail branch
empty-input/UnknownEOF is not promoted
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: READ status 00 deixa END=N; status 10 move END=Y; outros abendem. O teste de data acontece após o READ e antes do IF END=N/ELSE de totais.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Loop é limitado por registros status 00 + leitura EOF. O caminho EOF para totais é condicional ao teste textual anterior; arquivo vazio/receiver desconhecido deve ser modelado como unknown, não como total incondicional.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Não assumir retenção de último registro no EOF nem conteúdo estável do receiver.

selectedCells.title: Quebra por cartão e lookups
guardBasis: lookups for the in-range transaction have matching package-local indexed resources
absent lookup abend is not selected
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Em card novo escreve total anterior se não primeira ocorrência; lê XREF. Para todo registro lê tipo e categoria; chave ausente abende.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Detalhe usa account id e descrições dos arquivos de referência. Mudança de cartão materializa Account Total do cartão anterior.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Não há linha de erro/rejeição para lookup ausente.

selectedCells.title: Cabeçalhos e paginação
guardBasis: first-detail/header branch is selectable from one in-range transaction
page-boundary after 20 lines is not selected
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Primeiro detalhe escreve headers com date range; quando MOD(line-counter,20)=0 escreve page total e headers.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Headers contêm DALYREPT, Daily Transaction Report, Date Range e colunas do copybook.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Page-size conta linhas de header/totais; não é 20 detalhes.

selectedCells.title: Linha de detalhe e acumulação
guardBasis: detail/accrual branch has transaction and lookup bytes
edited-money expected formatting is not asserted
limits: No output/status oracle is created; this is local static selection only.

modelEvidence.preconditions: Lookups concluídos para registro no intervalo.
modelEvidence.guard_or_transition: Soma TRAN-AMT a WS-PAGE-TOTAL e WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL; move id, account, type code/desc, category code/desc, source e amount para detail.
modelEvidence.decidable_expectation: Cada transação processada no intervalo gera uma linha e acumula o valor exatamente nessa rotina.
modelEvidence.limits_and_review_notes: Edição monetária é a do PIC; sem arredondamento inventado.

blockedCells.title: Layout e cópia para transação postada
blockedCells.reason: observable posted-record layout depends on accepted path and generated timestamp; request {} + base fixture can select the run but not an independent expected field oracle

blockedCells.title: Atualização ACCOUNT e ordem de efeitos
blockedCells.reason: ACCOUNT update/order effect needs runtime/internal state authority; not selected by external package alone

blockedCells.title: WRITE TRANFILE após efeitos anteriores
blockedCells.reason: TRANFILE write/failure after prior effects remains precondition-indeterminate without execution-state authority

blockedCells.title: Update de conta em quebra de grupo
blockedCells.reason: group-break ACCOUNT update needs multi-group transition outcome; base package alone does not authorize expected effect

blockedCells.title: Última conta no EOF
blockedCells.reason: normal EOF final-account absence is a static source finding, not fixture-selectable expected behavior

blockedCells.title: Totais de página/grand no EOF condicional
blockedCells.reason: EOF totals depend on receiver/content behavior explicitly treated as conditional/unknown

blockedCells.title: Ausência de Account Total final no EOF
blockedCells.reason: absence of final account total is source-static and observation-inadmissible as external selection without report oracle
